sentences.text: Sean John Combs -LRB- born November 4 , 1969 -RRB- , also known by his stage names Puff Daddy , Puffy , P. Diddy and Diddy , is an American rapper , singer , songwriter , actor , record producer and entrepreneur .
He was born in Harlem and was raised in Mount Vernon , New York .	Harlem	Harlem

He worked as a talent director at Uptown Records before founding his label Bad Boy Entertainment in 1993 .	Bad Boy	Bad Boy Records	Uptown	Uptown Records	Uptown Records	Uptown Records	Bad Boy Entertainment	Bad Boy Entertainment

His debut album No Way Out -LRB- 1997 -RRB- has been certified seven times platinum and was followed by successful albums such as Forever -LRB- 1999 -RRB- , The Saga Continues ... -LRB- 2001 -RRB- , and Press Play -LRB- 2006 -RRB- .	No Way Out	No Way Out (Puff Daddy album)	seven times platinum	RIAA certification	Forever	Forever (Puff Daddy album)	Press Play	Press Play (album)

In 2009 Combs formed the musical group Diddy -- Dirty Money and released the critically well-reviewed and commercially successful album Last Train to Paris -LRB- 2010 -RRB- .	Last Train to Paris	Last Train to Paris
Combs has won three Grammy Awards and two MTV Video Music Awards , and is the producer of MTV 's Making the Band .	MTV	MTV	Making the Band	Making the Band
